To program the computer, speak to it one value at a time: "computer, range is 100", then "computer, theta is 345", then "computer, phi is 107", then "computer, confirm". Fasten the seat belt first.

Events in this game happen over time. When nothing seems to work, or the computer says it is waiting or holding course, type "wait" several times in a row and watch what happens. Stay in the couch with the seat belt fastened while waiting near the artifact: something may grab the ship.
Once the ship has reached the artifact and is tethered at the Red Dock, the computer's job is done: don't go back to program it, and don't try to fly anywhere.

After docking, the goal is to get inside the artifact and explore it. From the Red Dock, go up into the Red Airlock; it works like your ship's airlock (close one door before opening the other), and its inner door leads up into the interior.
